target.title: fix(ai): match reasoning efforts case-insensitively without lowering provider values
target.body:
Related: #102908
Alternative to #102958

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users or plugin/catalog authors who provide canonical OpenAI-compatible reasoning effort values with mixed casing, such as `HIGH` or `XHIGH`, can have the request miss the supported-effort list and fall through to a different effort.

## Why This Change Was Made

The resolver now folds only canonical OpenAI-owned reasoning effort names case-insensitively before lookup. Provider-native compat values remain exactly as configured, including mixed-case mapped API labels, so this avoids the compatibility risk called out on #102958 and preserves exact provider-native `reasoningEffortMap` outputs.

## User Impact

Users get the intended reasoning effort even when canonical effort values are written with different casing. Custom provider integrations can still return provider-specific mapped effort labels without OpenClaw lowercasing those payload values.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-reasoning-effort.test.ts` - passed, 13 tests
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write --threads=1 packages/ai/src/providers/openai-reasoning-effort.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-reasoning-effort.test.ts` - completed
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD -- packages/ai/src/providers/openai-reasoning-effort.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-reasoning-effort.test.ts` - passed
- Previous single autoreview round for the draft branch was clean; not repeated after this narrow review-comment repair to stay within the draft PR guardrail.
- `node_modules/.bin/tsx - < temporary proof script` - passed, using a loopback OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint through `createOpenAICompletionsTransportStreamFn()` plus the Responses request builder. Redacted payload proof:

```json
{
  "chatCompletionsMixedCaseCanonical": {
    "requestPath": "/v1/chat/completions",
    "inputReasoning": " XHIGH ",
    "capturedReasoningEffort": "xhigh"
  },
  "chatCompletionsProviderNativeMap": {
    "requestPath": "/v1/chat/completions",
    "inputReasoning": "HIGH",
    "compatSupportedReasoningEfforts": ["ProviderDefault"],
    "compatReasoningEffortMap": { "high": "ProviderDefault" },
    "capturedReasoningEffort": "ProviderDefault"
  },
  "chatCompletionsCanonicalLookingProviderNativeMap": {
    "requestPath": "/v1/chat/completions",
    "inputReasoning": "HIGH",
    "compatSupportedReasoningEfforts": ["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH"],
    "compatReasoningEffortMap": { "high": "HIGH" },
    "capturedReasoningEffort": "HIGH"
  },
  "responsesMixedCaseCanonical": {
    "inputReasoningEffort": " XHIGH ",
    "capturedReasoningEffort": "xhigh"
  }
}
```

Remote proof note: Blacksmith Testbox was unavailable locally because the `blacksmith` executable is missing, and Crabbox is blocked here by a missing configured coordinator. This PR uses the documented narrow Codex-worktree local fallback for the focused unit test and loopback request-path proof.
